name: vrchat-mcp
description: MCP server for controlling VRChat avatars and assets with FastMCP 2.12+
author: Sandra Schi

prompts.name: load_avatar_preset
prompts.template: Load the VRChat avatar preset named {preset_name}.

prompts.name: set_avatar_parameter
prompts.description: Set a parameter on the current VRChat avatar
prompts.template: Set the {parameter_name} parameter to {value} on the current VRChat avatar.

prompts.name: play_animation
prompts.description: Play an animation on the VRChat avatar
prompts.template: Play the {animation_name} animation on the VRChat avatar with {speed}x speed.

prompts.name: set_expression
prompts.description: Set a facial expression on the VRChat avatar
prompts.template: Set the {expression_name} expression with {intensity}% intensity on the VRChat avatar.

prompts.name: npc_start_conversation
prompts.description: Start a conversation with an NPC
prompts.template: Start a conversation with the NPC named {npc_name} about {topic}.
